decision.summary: NO_ACTION: the 08:00 BTC daily thesis trade already hit take profit, so the hard post-win daily cooldown blocks any new daily entry.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Trade history shows the 08:00 daily thesis position `will-bitcoin-dip-to-78k-on-may-16` Yes was opened and then fully closed at 09:20 UTC for `take_profit` at 0.999, so there is no remaining open position to close or reduce. Under the playbook's strict post-win daily cooldown, once any BTC daily REACH/DIP position resolves in our favor or is exited via take-profit during the current UTC day, no additional BTC daily position may be opened until the next UTC day. That hard gate overrides fresh scouting at 10:00 UTC. The live board also shows the 78k DIP already essentially resolved near 0.999, while the next downside strike 77k DIP is only around 0.21 and would in any case be disallowed today after the win.
